{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_customers = sales[sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check if any of the QA rows (revenue = 999999.99) are in the loyal segment
qa_rows = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
qa_in_loyal = qa_rows[qa_rows['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Count how many QA rows are in loyal segment
n_qa_in_loyal = len(qa_in_loyal)

# Check if they converted
qa_converted_in_loyal = qa_in_loyal['converted'].sum()

# Print results
print(f"Number of QA rows in loyal segment: {n_qa_in_loyal}")
print(f"Number of QA rows in loyal segment that converted: {qa_converted_in_loyal}")"}
